rationale: The agent did perform back-end actions: it located the user via email lookups, retrieved user and order details, and executed an exchange on a delivered item. However, the policy requires explicit user authentication, confirmation before any order-changing write, and correct final information. The conversation provided shows no explicit confirmation from the user prior to executing exchange_delivered_order_items, nor any clear final details of the exchange (e.g., item/size/color confirmed, return instructions, costs/payment method confirmation). While the tool calls suggest the agent acted on the correct user's orders, the absence of visible confirmation and final information means the agent did not meet the stated policy requirements. Therefore, the outcome fails the pass bar.
